summary: Cloudflare adapters and Project Loro processing helpers.
context_hints: replica-ports.ts adapts Durable Object Storage and alarms to @clash/replica; durable ordering belongs to the portable engine.
storage.ts retains compatibility helpers and stable storage key definitions. Do not introduce foreign keys or runtime-specific types into @clash/replica.
Full snapshots remain the default until an offline-replica-aware shallow-history GC frontier exists.

key_files.presence-device.ts: Short display-only presence device labels derived from browser User-Agent or bounded CLI/Host declarations; never an identity or kind authority.
key_files.replica-ports.ts: Durable Object event log, checkpoint, deduplication and scheduling ports.
key_files.storage.ts: Existing snapshot/update storage keys and migration-compatible helpers.
key_files.NodeProcessor.ts: Hosted caller glue to journal-first startGeneration, plus reconcileUnadmittedTasks: at room init a pendingTask without a journal row fails with GENERATION_ADMISSION_LOST; a failed lookup asks for a retry. Completion arrives by publication push; the room never polls. Retired automatic description no-op is not scheduled.
key_files.auth.ts: Cloudflare D1, in-process Better Auth (never a fetch to the request origin; BETTER_AUTH_ORIGIN is an explicit external override) and jose adapters for shared-runtime/project-authorization; exported authenticate/revalidate wrappers preserve existing DO call sites.
